system.description:
You master the use of weapons with a long reach, capable to striking enemies at a slight distance from you. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Lance Weapons. You gain the following benefits;

When you take the Attack action, you can use a bonus action to make one additional melee weapon attack with the opposite end of your weapon. The damage die for this attack is one step lower than the weapon's normal damage die.

Other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter your reach.

When you make an opportunity attack with a Lance Weapon, you can choose to push the triggering creature 10 feet in any direction instead of dealing damage. This forced movement can trigger opportunity attacks from your allies and it also spends the affected creatures movement if they have any remaining.

Beginning at 5th level, when you make a weapon attack or a melee Taijutsu attack using a Lance Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Sweeping Attack.

Sweeping Attack. Make a weapon attack targeting all creatures in a cone originating from you with a length equal to your weapon's reach, vs the AC of all creatures in range, dealing [Weapon Damage] on a hit. You can move all affected creatures 5 feet away from you as part of this attack.

Beginning at 10th level, when you move a creature as a result of this stances abilities, you can force them to make a Strength saving throw vs your Taijutsu save DC. On a failure, you knock them Prone.
